news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Initiates Coverage with Buy Rating, C$1.54 Price Target
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets started coverage of Perimeter (TSXV:PINK; OTCQX:PYNKF) with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, versus a C$0.32 close on July 13. The target is based on a 10-year DCF assuming sharp 2026 uptake of Claire OCT followed by steady growth toward 9%+ lumpectomy penetration by 2035.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter a New Healthcare Top Pick
news.summary: Paradigm Capital named Perimeter a new Top Pick with a speculative buy rating and C$0.95 price target, versus a C$0.275 close on July 3. The analyst cited the March 2026 FDA PMA approval of Claire as positioning the company to accelerate commercial rollout and draw more market interest.

news.headline: Perimeter Presents Company Update at Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: CEO Adrian Mendes presented a company update on Perimeter's commercial strategy for Claire OCT+AI and discussed upcoming milestones to investors at the Planet MicroCap Showcase. The event offered one-on-one investor meetings alongside the presentation, part of the company's push to broaden its small-cap investor base.

news.headline: Perimeter Closes Final Tranche of Non-Brokered Convertible Debenture Placement
news.summary: Perimeter closed the second and final tranche of its non-brokered private placement of 3.59% convertible debentures maturing April 2029, issuing CDN$3.28 million and bringing the total raised across both tranches to CDN$6.04 million. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes as the company scales Claire's commercial launch.

news.headline: Perimeter Reports Q1 2026 Results: Net Loss Narrows 31% as Recurring Revenue Grows
news.summary: Perimeter reported Q1 2026 revenue of about $385,000, all recurring, and a net loss of roughly $3.0 million (versus $4.3 million a year earlier), with operating cash burn down 41% year-over-year. Including subsequent debenture and LIFE offering proceeds, management cited over $9.5 million in pro forma liquidity providing roughly a 12-month runway.

news.headline: FDA Grants PMA Approval to Claire, First AI-Enabled Imaging Device for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter's Claire OCT+AI device received full FDA premarket approval, becoming the first AI-enabled imaging device cleared in the U.S. for intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment, with 88.1% margin accuracy demonstrated in its pivotal trial. The approval, built on Breakthrough Device designation, underpins the commercial rollout and analyst coverage that followed through mid-2026.

catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision
catalysts.detail: Perimeter is pursuing Medicare reimbursement for Claire via the New Technology APC (and TCET) pathway; Claire's Breakthrough Device status should speed CMS review, and a favorable decision would be a major catalyst for hospital adoption economics, but no official CMS decision date has been confirmed.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has not yet announced a specific date for its Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30) earnings release and conference call as of Aug 7, 2026; third-party estimate trackers show unconfirmed placeholder dates ranging from late Aug to Sep 1, 2026.

catalysts.label: Continued commercial rollout of Claire OCT+AI
catalysts.detail: Following March 2026 FDA PMA approval, Perimeter is scaling commercial placements of Claire (successor to the S-Series) across existing hospital relationships (e.g., Intermountain Health, Medical City Dallas) and pursuing new health-system agreements from a sales funnel of close to 50 qualified leads; incremental placement/adoption announcements are a recurring near-term catalyst.

pulse: Perimeter continues commercializing its FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI device for intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment, with analyst attention building: Paradigm Capital (Top Pick, C$0.95 target) and Brookline Capital Markets (Buy, C$1.54 target) both initiated bullish coverage in the first half of July 2026, following a Q1 2026 print that showed a 31% narrower net loss and improving cash burn. No major company-specific news has emerged since mid-July, leaving the CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision and the still-undated Q2 2026 earnings release as the key near-term catalysts to watch.
